description:
# 🧱 New Plugin

## 🔗 Closes


## 🚀 Summary
The SPARC Static Validator plugin provides comprehensive **syntax validation** for tool call arguments before execution. Using the **SPARC (Semantic Pre-execution Analysis for Reliable Calls)** component from the Agent Lifecycle Toolkit (ALTK), it catches common errors like missing required parameters, type mismatches, and invalid values (with correction suggestions when possible) — all without requiring an LLM. (See README file for a more detailed description)


## 🧪 Checks

- [ ] Plugin was [bootstrapped with the CLI](https://ibm.github.io/mcp-context-forge/using/plugins/lifecycle/) (native or external template)
- [x] Unit tests created for the new plugin
- [x] `make lint plugins` passes
- [x] `make test` passes
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated (if user-facing)
- [x] README documentation was created for the plugin
- [ ] New plugin added to the [documentation](https://ibm.github.io/mcp-context-forge/using/plugins/plugins/) linking to the README above
